instance_recipe_contract.REMOVE: remove the existing value at path
instance_recipe_contract.SET: deep-copy value to path, replacing an existing value or creating the final object member
instance_recipe_contract.initial_value: deep copy of the named top-level template
instance_recipe_contract.mutation_order: array order, from first to last
instance_recipe_contract.pointer: slash-separated object names or zero-based array indexes; ~0 denotes ~ and ~1 denotes /
